🔒
Tamper-Proof Ledger
Every certificate is hashed and recorded on our immutable distributed ledger. No certificate can be altered, duplicated, or forged — giving you irrefutable proof of ownership.
⚖️
SEC-Backed Legal Standing
Each digital certificate corresponds to a signed subscription agreement and PPM. Your ownership is legally enforceable under the applicable SEC exemption rule.
🔄
Transferable & Tradeable
After your lock-up period, certificates can be listed and sold in the secondary marketplace. Transfer of ownership triggers an automatic certificate re-issuance to the new holder.
📊
Real-Time Distribution Tracking
Quarterly distributions are auto-calculated pro-rata based on your certificate ownership %. All distribution history is visible within your certificate and investor portal.

SEC Compliance

Fully Regulated Offerings
Under Federal Securities Law

Rule 506(b)
Reg D — Accredited + Up to 35 Sophisticated
506(b)
No general solicitation or advertising. Available to accredited investors and up to 35 sophisticated non-accredited investors. No SEC registration required.
General SolicitationNot Allowed
Investor TypeAccredited + 35 Non-Accredited
Raise CapUnlimited
SEC RegistrationNot Required
Resale Restrictions12-month lockup
Financial StatementsNot Required (but recommended)
Rule 506(c)
Reg D — Verified Accredited Only
506(c)
General solicitation allowed. All investors must be verified accredited investors. Issuer must take reasonable steps to verify accreditation status.
General SolicitationAllowed
Investor TypeVerified Accredited Only
Raise CapUnlimited
Verification RequiredYes — Tax Returns or CPA Letter
Resale Restrictions12-month lockup
Regulation A+
Mini-IPO — All Investors Welcome
Reg A+
Available to all investors, accredited and non-accredited. Raise up to $75M in any 12-month period. Full SEC qualification required. Annual reports required.
General SolicitationAllowed
Investor TypeAll Investors
Raise Cap$75M / 12 months
SEC QualificationRequired (Tier 2)
Non-Accredited Limit10% of income/net worth
Regulation CF
Equity Crowdfunding — Up to $5M
Reg CF
Crowdfunding for non-accredited investors. Raise up to $5M per year. Must use SEC-registered crowdfunding portal. Investment limits based on investor income.
Raise Cap$5M / 12 months
Investor TypeAll Investors
Non-Accred. Annual Limit$2,500 or 5% income
Portal RequiredYes — SEC/FINRA Registered
Resale Restriction1 year
🔐 Accredited Investor Requirements
  • Individual income exceeding $200,000 in each of the two most recent years (or $300,000 jointly with spouse)
  • Net worth exceeding $1,000,000 (excluding primary residence)
  • Holding in good standing a Series 7, 65, or 82 financial license
  • Certain entity types with $5M+ in assets (trusts, funds, family offices)
Verify Your Status
EQUIVEST uses Parallel Markets for automated accreditation verification. Takes 5 minutes. Results are valid for 90 days and unlock all 506(b) and 506(c) offerings.
⚠️ Important Disclosures
  • All investments carry risk including total loss of principal. Past performance is not indicative of future results.
  • Real estate investments are illiquid and may be subject to extended holding periods beyond stated lock-up dates.
  • Projected yields are estimates only and not guaranteed. Actual distributions may vary.
  • EQUIVEST is not a registered investment advisor. Consult your financial and tax advisor before investing.
